Scheduling Experiments

Here are a few guidelines for scheduling our lab time:
To reserve a block of time,

  • Fill out the Wufoo Experiment Description Form, which can be found at: https://sccn.wufoo.com/forms/sccn-experiment-description/
  • Fill out the Wufoo Lab Scheduling Form, which can be found at: https://sccn.wufoo.com/forms/sccn-lab-scheduling-form/
  • Submit your requests by Friday of the week before you are requesting time
  • Do not submit requests for more than 2 weeks in advance
  • Serial requests need to be resubmitted every 2 weeks
  • Subjects will be provided unless otherwise specified
  • Please contact experiments@sccn.ucsd.edu with any questions

Human Subjects Payment Procedure

  • 2 weeks before you know you will be running a group of subjects, fill out the Wufoo Experiment Description form at: https://sccn.wufoo.com/forms/sccn-experiment-description/. Include the number of subjects, and how much money you will need for each (if amount differs from standard $15/hour)

Human Subject payments in the form of scrip are available from an SRA and will be provided directly to the subject following an experiment. If no SRA is present during the study, please make arrangements beforehand with Tyler.
